## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(bayestestR)
library(purrr)
library(bayesplot)
library(loo)
library(here)
```

### Import saved imputed dfs

```{r import-data}
analytic_dfs <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "analytic_dfs.rds"))
```

### Initial checks

```{r initial-checks}
length(analytic_dfs)
sapply(analytic_dfs, nrow) |> unique()
str(analytic_dfs[[1]])
```

### Create folders

```{r folders}
dir.create(here("Exploratory Model"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Prior predictive check

```{r prior-predictive-check}
prior_med <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", resp = "erstotals"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "erstotals"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma", resp = "erstotals"),

  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", resp = "smfqtotals"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "smfqtotals"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma", resp = "smfqtotals"),

  prior(lkj(5), class = "rescor")
)

bf_mediator <- bf(
  ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status + sed_percentile_s
)

bf_outcome <- bf(
  smfq_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s + adhd_status + sed_percentile_s +
    ers_total_s
)

fit_med_prior <- brm(
  bf_mediator + bf_outcome + set_rescor(TRUE),
  data = analytic_dfs[[1]],
  prior = prior_med,
  sample_prior = "only",
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  seed = 123
)

# Mediator equation (ERS)
yrep_mediator <- posterior_predict(fit_med_prior, resp = "erstotals")
range(yrep_mediator)
mean(yrep_mediator)
sd(as.vector(yrep_mediator))
quantile(as.vector(yrep_mediator), c(.01, .05, .5, .95, .99))

# Outcome equation (SMFQ)
yrep_outcome <- posterior_predict(fit_med_prior, resp = "smfqtotals")
range(yrep_outcome)
mean(yrep_outcome)
sd(as.vector(yrep_outcome))
quantile(as.vector(yrep_outcome), c(.01, .05, .5, .95, .99))

# Stats
ppd_stat(yrep_mediator, stat = "mean")
ppd_stat(yrep_mediator, stat = "sd")

ppd_stat(yrep_outcome, stat = "mean")
ppd_stat(yrep_outcome, stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== prior summary: fit_med_prior ===\n")
prior_summary(fit_med_prior)

cat("\n=== model summary: fit_med_prior ===\n")
summary(fit_med_prior)
```

## Moderated Mediation

```{r moderated-mediation}
# Formulas
bf_mediator <- bf(
  ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status + sed_percentile_s
)

bf_outcome <- bf(
  smfq_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s + adhd_status + sed_percentile_s +
    ers_total_s
)

# Model fit
fit_med <- brm_multiple(
  bf_mediator + bf_outcome + set_rescor(TRUE),
  data = analytic_dfs,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = prior_med,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000, 
  cores = 4,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_med, here("Exploratory Model", "fit_med.rds"))
```

### Moderated Mediation output

```{r moderated-mediation-output}
draws <- as_draws_df(fit_med)

# Coefficient names
a1          <- "b_erstotals_pubertal_timing_s"
a3          <- "b_erstotals_pubertal_timing_s:adhd_statusY"
b           <- "b_smfqtotals_ers_total_s"
cprime_pt   <- "b_smfqtotals_pubertal_timing_s"
cprime_adhd <- "b_smfqtotals_adhd_statusY"
adhd_to_ers <- "b_erstotals_adhd_statusY"

# Compute effects
effects <- draws %>%
  transmute(
    # Path a: pubertal timing -> ERS, conditional on ADHD status
    a_noADHD = .data[[a1]],
    a_ADHD   = .data[[a1]] + .data[[a3]],

    # Path a moderation: difference in a-path between ADHD and non-ADHD
    a_moderation = .data[[a3]],

    # Path b: ERS -> SMFQ
    b_path = .data[[b]],

    # Other paths
    adhd_ers   = .data[[adhd_to_ers]],
    adhd_smfq  = .data[[cprime_adhd]],

    # Direct effect (pubertal timing -> SMFQ)
    cprime = .data[[cprime_pt]],

    # Conditional indirect effects
    ind_noADHD = a_noADHD * b_path,
    ind_ADHD   = a_ADHD   * b_path,

    # Index of moderated mediation
    index_mod_med = a_moderation * b_path,

    # Total effects at each ADHD level
    tot_noADHD = cprime + ind_noADHD,
    tot_ADHD   = cprime + ind_ADHD
  )

# Metric functions
pd_pct <- function(x) max(mean(x > 0), mean(x < 0)) * 100

rope_prop <- function(x, lower = -0.1, upper = 0.1) {
  mean(x > lower & x < upper) * 100
}

summary_effect <- function(x, rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1)) {
  h <- bayestestR::hdi(x, ci = 0.95)
  c(
    Median = median(x),
    `Lower 95% HDI` = h$CI_low,
    `Upper 95% HDI` = h$CI_high,
    PD = pd_pct(x),
    ROPE = rope_prop(x, rope_range[1], rope_range[2])
  )
}

# Summary
mediation_summary <- bind_rows(
  # Path a
  `Path a (non-ADHD): timing -> ERS`   = summary_effect(effects$a_noADHD),
  `Path a (ADHD): timing -> ERS`       = summary_effect(effects$a_ADHD),
  `Path a moderation (timing x ADHD)`  = summary_effect(effects$a_moderation),

  # Path b
  `Path b: ERS -> SMFQ`                = summary_effect(effects$b_path),

  # Other paths
  `ADHD -> ERS`                        = summary_effect(effects$adhd_ers),
  `ADHD -> SMFQ (adjusted)`            = summary_effect(effects$adhd_smfq),

  # Mediation effects
  `Indirect (non-ADHD)`                = summary_effect(effects$ind_noADHD, rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1)),
  `Indirect (ADHD)`                    = summary_effect(effects$ind_ADHD,   rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1)),
  `Index of Moderated Mediation`       = summary_effect(effects$index_mod_med, rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1)),
  Direct                               = summary_effect(effects$cprime),
  `Total (non-ADHD)`                   = summary_effect(effects$tot_noADHD),
  `Total (ADHD)`                       = summary_effect(effects$tot_ADHD),
  .id = "Effect"
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

mediation_summary
```

### Moderated Mediation diagnostics

```{r moderated-mediation-diagnostics}
cat("=== Rhat and ESS ===\n")
cat("Rhat values close to 1 indicate convergence. ESS should ideally be > 400.\n")

as_draws_df(fit_med) %>% summarise_draws(default_convergence_measures())

cat("\n=== Divergent Transitions ===\n")
cat("Ideally 0. Large numbers indicate sampler problems.\n\n")
cat("Number of divergent transitions:",
    sum(nuts_params(fit_med)$Parameter == "divergent__" &
          nuts_params(fit_med)$Value == 1),
    "\n")

# Trace plots
cat("\n=== Trace Plots ===\n")
mcmc_trace(fit_med, regex_pars = "^b_") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Prior Summary
cat("\n=== Prior Summary ===\n")
cat("Priors specified for the model.\n\n")
prior_summary(fit_med)

# Posterior Predictive Checks
cat("\n=== Posterior Predictive Checks ===\n")
cat("Density plots for each parameter.\n\n")
plot(fit_med, ask = FALSE)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay (Mediator: ers_total_s) ===\n")
cat("y_rep lines should closely follow the observed y distribution.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "erstotals", ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay (Outcome: smfq_total_s) ===\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals", ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram (Mediator) ===\n")
cat("Errors should be approximately normally distributed around 0.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "erstotals", type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram (Outcome) ===\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals", type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean (Mediator) ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "erstotals", type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean (Outcome) ===\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals", type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median (Mediator) ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "erstotals", type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median (Outcome) ===\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals", type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD (Mediator) ===\n")
cat("Observed SD (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated SDs.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "erstotals", type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD (Outcome) ===\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals", type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average (Mediator) ===\n")
cat("Points should cluster around the diagonal. Systematic patterns indicate misfit.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "erstotals", type = "scatter_avg")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average (Outcome) ===\n")
pp_check(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals", type = "scatter_avg")

# Pareto-k
cat("\n=== Pareto-k: Joint model (both equations combined) ===\n")
loo_med <- loo(fit_med)
pareto_k_table(loo_med)
plot(loo_med, label_points = TRUE)

cat("\n=== Pareto-k: Mediator equation only ===\n")
loo_med_ers <- loo(fit_med, resp = "erstotals")
pareto_k_table(loo_med_ers)
plot(loo_med_ers, label_points = TRUE)

cat("\n=== Pareto-k: Outcome equation only ===\n")
loo_med_smfq <- loo(fit_med, resp = "smfqtotals")
pareto_k_table(loo_med_smfq)
plot(loo_med_smfq, label_points = TRUE)
```
